text:
anna: Quick note after a user report: Quickstart Gemfile pulls in faraday via oauth2 and conflicts with common plugins. Thinking we should publish a tiny example Gemfile for minimal installs.

devon: Sounds useful. Could we instead vendor a tiny HTTP adapter that avoids faraday for the sampleapp? That keeps parity.

mike: I worry about maintenance if we vendor. Simpler: update Quickstart to show two Gemfiles: Gemfile.minimal and Gemfile.full. Minimal uses net-http adapter and no oauth gem. Full shows auth flow.

anna: Proposed minimal Gemfile snippet:```ruby
source 'https://rubygems.org'
gem 'redwood-minimal', '~> 0.1'
# use builtin adapter to avoid faraday/oauth2 deps
```

ci-bot: ci: ruby-3.2 job #1420 reported bundler error: "Bundler could not find compatible versions for gem \"faraday\"" — exact motivator for minimal flow.

devon: Good plan. Action items: 1) add Gemfile.minimal to repo, 2) update Quickstart docs with both flows, 3) add CI smoke that installs minimal Gemfile on ruby-3.1 and ruby-3.2.
mike: I'll draft the docs patch and a tiny test that ensures the net-http adapter works with streaming.

anna: Thanks — I'll open the PR and tag you both.
